seoDescription: Get a first look at the Ionic 6 beta release and discover the latest features. This overview covers new UI components, including the highly anticipated Accordion and Breadcrumbs, plus a completely redesigned Datetime component that improves the user experience on both mobile and desktop. Learn about the simplified upgrade process from Ionic 5, the new yearly release cadence aligned with OS updates, and what breaking changes to expect. The video also previews upcoming components and discusses the deprecation of Virtual Scroll and Ion Slides.

summary:
## Ionic 6 Overview: New Cadence and Easy Upgrades

- Ionic is simplifying its branding, referring to the UI toolkit as just **"Framework"** moving forward.
- A new, more reliable release cadence is being adopted: **one major version per year**, aligning with annual iOS and Android releases.
- Framework 6 aims to be ready for **iOS 15** and future Material Design updates at launch.
- The upgrade from version 5 to 6 is expected to be **very simple**, with minimal breaking changes. Most breaking changes are isolated to the `ion-datetime` component.

> [!TIP]
> For Angular users, upgrading to the beta is as simple as running `ng add @ionic/angular@next` in your project.

## New UI Components

Ionic 6 introduces several new components, with a focus on improving the desktop and PWA experience.

### **Ion Breadcrumbs**

- A classic navigation component ideal for desktop web apps.
- Automatically **collapses** items into a popover when space is limited.
- Highly customizable with properties for `max-items` and slots for custom separator icons.

### **Ion Accordion**

- A native solution for creating collapsible sections of content.
- Features **smooth animations** and is accessible via keyboard navigation.
- Implemented using an `ion-accordion-group` wrapper around individual `ion-accordion` elements.
- You can place any content, such as lists or cards, inside the accordion's `content` slot.

## Overhauled & Upcoming Components

### **Ion Datetime (Completely Reworked)**

- `ion-datetime` has been completely rebuilt to provide a better user experience on all platforms.
- The new component can be presented as a full calendar view or within a modal for a more traditional mobile picker UI.
- It eliminates the clunky desktop UI of the previous version.

> [!NOTE]
> The component is still in beta and some features, like the time picker UI, may not be fully functional yet.

### **Upcoming: Bottom Drawer & Desktop Select**

- **Bottom Drawer**: A component that can be pulled up from the bottom of the screen, common in modern mobile apps.
- **Desktop Select**: A new version of `ion-select` designed specifically for a better desktop user experience, likely behaving more like a native dropdown.

## Deprecations in Version 6

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The following components are deprecated in Framework 6 and will be **removed in Framework 7**.

- **Ion Virtual Scroll**: This component is being removed because it was Angular-only and better, framework-specific virtual scrolling solutions exist (e.g., from the Angular CDK, React Virtualized).
- **Ion Slides**: Since this component is essentially a wrapper around Swiper.js, Ionic will deprecate it. Developers are encouraged to use the official Swiper.js integrations for Angular, React, or Vue directly.
